plugins.name: Abomerration
plugins.description: Chromatic-aberration effect with radial and directional modes and a sound-reactive option. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Anime Smoother
plugins.description: CPU anti-aliasing for anime and cel-style line art: smooths jagged edges while keeping flat fills intact. Ported from loilo-inc/smooth.

plugins.name: Asciify
plugins.description: ASCII-art effect that maps each cell's dominant tone to a character ramp, with selectable palettes. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Blackmagic RAW
plugins.description: OpenFX reader for Blackmagic RAW footage in Natron. Requires the Blackmagic RAW SDK to be installed.

plugins.name: Boilify
plugins.description: Procedural boil / heat-haze distortion with animated noise, adjustable speed and seed. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Cogwheel
plugins.description: Spirograph generator: two tooth counts and subtractive ink produce mechanical rosettes. No input clip required. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Colourunder
plugins.description: VHS-deck look: colour-under chroma, tape wobble and dropouts for Resolve, Vegas, Nuke and Natron. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Compander
plugins.description: Analogue radio-microphone companding circuit applied to the image, with drive and noise-floor controls. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: DomeWarp
plugins.description: Fulldome / fisheye / equirectangular projection converter and spherical warp for VR and planetarium work.

plugins.name: Downpour
plugins.description: Digital-rain generator: streams of glyphs with adjustable speed, trail and glow. Works as a generator with no input clip. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: F's Plugins
plugins.description: Eight line-treatment effects in one bundle: selective colour blur, colour switch, rim fill, line extraction, thin, main-line repaint, select colour and edge line.

plugins.name: Film Juicer
plugins.description: GPU film emulation with negative/print stocks, halation, grain and lab processing for Resolve on Windows and Linux.

plugins.name: Gaffer
plugins.description: Simulated lens on a depth map, with focus pulls and aperture bokeh. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: Glasspectrum
plugins.description: GPU lens emulation with 50 cinema lens presets, bokeh and flare controls for DaVinci Resolve.

plugins.name: Gyroflow
plugins.description: Gyroscope-based video stabilization as an OpenFX filter.

plugins.name: Humbaba
plugins.description: Depth, distortion and focal-length prediction from scene-referred colour, exposed as an OpenFX plugin with CoreML/CUDA acceleration.

plugins.name: Hush OpenNR
plugins.description: Motion-adaptive temporal noise reduction for DaVinci Resolve's free edition, with luma/chroma separation and detail preservation.

plugins.name: Invert (Developer Sample)
plugins.description: Reference Invert filter built from the official OpenFX 1.5.1 SDK. macOS arm64 binary; Windows and Linux point to the upstream sample source.

plugins.name: LensCorrect
plugins.description: Lens correction and projection conversion (rectilinear, fisheye, equirectangular, stereographic) for Resolve on Apple Silicon.

plugins.name: LIC
plugins.description: Line integral convolution effect for flow-like stylisation of an image. Linux x86-64 build.

plugins.name: Macroblock
plugins.description: Chroma subsampling and block-art filter: any block size from 4:2:0 to a single colour, with presets for retro video looks. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: MakeHDR
plugins.description: Bracketed-exposure HDR merge with Debevec / Robertson solving and tone mapping. One archive ships macOS arm64, Windows x64 and Linux x86-64 binaries.

plugins.name: ME_OpenDRT
plugins.description: OpenDRT v1.1.0 port for Resolve with input/output gamut, tone-mapping controls and a preset manager. Metal/CPU on macOS, CUDA/OpenCL/CPU elsewhere.

plugins.name: Nikita Blend
plugins.description: Original blend mode that mixes two layers using the average colour of the top layer, with clamp and bottom-layer blend controls.

plugins.name: NTSC-RS
plugins.description: VHS / analogue TV artefact simulator (NTSC encode-decode, ringing, colour fringing). Windows and Linux ship OFX archives; the macOS OFX build is a pkg installer.

plugins.name: ODT N6 Color
plugins.description: Open Display Transform look tools ported from Resolve DCTLs to OFX, with N6 colour rendering.

plugins.name: OpenDefocus
plugins.description: Physically based defocus and bokeh with depth-aware convolution, catseye, barndoors and astigmatism. GPU (Vulkan/Metal) OpenFX plugin.

plugins.name: OpenFX Arena
plugins.description: ImageMagick-based effects for OFX hosts, including distortion, stylize and color tools.

plugins.name: OpenFX Community
plugins.description: Natron community OpenFX bundle: Looks film emulation, Opacity, ChannelMath and the INK keyer.

plugins.name: OpenFX Developer Samples
plugins.description: Reference OpenFX plugins: Invert, Noise generator, Cross-fade transition and Retimer. Useful for host compatibility testing.

plugins.name: OpenFX G'MIC
plugins.description: G'MIC image processing effects exposed as OFX filters.

plugins.name: OpenFX IO
plugins.description: OpenImageIO / FFmpeg readers and writers plus OpenColorIO color management for OFX hosts.

plugins.name: OpenFX Misc
plugins.description: Essential compositing filters, generators and transitions from the Natron project.

plugins.name: purzOS OFX
plugins.description: 64 deterministic retro, analog, glitch, pixel-art and CRT/VHS effects for Resolve, Natron and other OpenFX hosts.

plugins.name: QRcoder
plugins.description: QR code generator with adjustable border and foreground / background colours.

plugins.name: Resolve DLSS5
plugins.description: Experimental NVIDIA DLSS neural rendering and denoising for DaVinci Resolve on RTX GPUs.

plugins.name: Smooth
plugins.description: Pixel-boundary smoothing filter that cleans up stair-step patterns; CPU implementation with 8/16/32-bit support.

plugins.name: Speak
plugins.description: Film emulation with H&D tone curves, subtractive colour, halation and grain for DaVinci Resolve.

plugins.name: Tilter
plugins.description: Tilt-shift lens with a movable focus band and a real aperture, for miniature looks. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: TuttleOFX
plugins.description: Suite of OpenFX plugins and a batch host covering image processing, colour, compositing and video I/O.

plugins.name: Vertigo
plugins.description: Dolly-zoom (vertigo) effect: keeps the subject fixed while the background expands or compresses. CPU render, 8/16/32-bit.

plugins.name: zzzFX
plugins.description: Open-source retro, glitch and CRT effects with OpenFX, After Effects, Premiere and AviUtl2 builds.
